body.title: Describe the minimum project lifecycle, without an economy
body.body:
## What is delivered
A description of the minimum project lifecycle, with no economy of its own attached: create a project, set an objective, invite a participant, review a proposal, record a contribution, and close or reuse the project.

Six steps, each one saying what has to exist for it to happen and what is left behind when it does. No funding, no reputation, no distribution — those depend on components that are themselves unspecified, and pulling them in here is what keeps this from being written.

## Why it is needed
Projects & Applications is meant to be where every other project in the ecosystem lives, which makes it the piece most likely to be designed by accumulation. A lifecycle small enough to describe in one document is what makes the rest arguable.

## Where to start
The hardest step is the last one. Deciding what happens to a project that ends — discarded, archived, or turned into something another project can clone — shapes everything before it.

## Prior material

Drayker has earlier work on this subject in its own knowledge base — drafts, mostly in Portuguese, written before the public repositories took their current shape. It is not published yet. If you take this function, say so in the thread and the relevant material will be published alongside it, so you are consolidating and arguing with existing thinking rather than starting from a blank page.

---
This is an open function: small enough for one person to finish, defined enough that the result composes with the rest. Claim it in this thread before starting so two people do not carry the same function, and deliver through a pull request to `master`. It appears on the board at https://drayker.org/fn/

body.title: Project resources bound to their purpose; first worked example
body.body:
Alignment pass across the `draykerdk` organization, on the branch `alinhamento/2026-09` in every affected repository.

## Changes

- docs: project resources and the worked example as in the book (2.7.1, ch. 39, 48, 50)
- docs: remove book citations

## Across the organization

- Governance corrected: PAP is Projects & Applications, DFMP is the DFM proposal process, the founding account is `Hyadhuad`, and the governance horizon runs from the founding Embassy through the DAF into PAP.
- The veto chain specified in UID: signed, hash-linked vetoes that carry their real grounds even when anonymous; vetoes weighed by grounds, not counted; one veto with grounds beyond the decision's scope can lead to an adjustment after advanced triage.
- Direction states 2033 as the objective, measured by what works rather than by the date.
- Intelligence is a partner, never the master.
- English is the canonical documentation language.
- Documentation states its own claims and does not cite outside books as authority.

Documentation only. Nothing here claims an implemented system.

Supersedes #4, closed when the branch was renamed.

body.title: pap: Dk can create and evolve projects on its own
body.body:
## What changes
README: a fifth way to build a project — Dk recognizes needs and potential in the ecosystem and creates projects, or evolves existing projects and applications, on its own or with groups of members.

## Why
Restores part of the founder's original design that earlier edits had left out (sweep of 2026-10-05). Founder's instruction: "pode atualizar tudo".

body.title: PAP: DAF is its primitive form today
body.body:
The README says that DAF, where durable coordination functions are tested, is a basic and primitive form of PAP implemented now, testing its dynamics as the very way Drayker is built.

Founder decision (06/10/2026): DAF "é nossa forma de implementar uma noção básica e primitiva do que será a PAP no agora, e já testar a dinâmica como a própria forma de construção".

body.body:

- README: an open project can be reused as the base of another and adapted, and a validated improvement can return to the original.
- llms.txt: Drayker is the supersystem.

## Founder

> "Ela não é definível, a única definição que cabe é de super sistema."
